_note: Tier-1 sweep batch 003, 20-21 August 2026: WCSr1gn7mlM, -Z-oPJQyOeU. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He replays a vision dated 26 March in which he saw three big banks, Chase among them, alongside Brad Garlinghouse at the edge of a launch.
mentions.quote: Saw the three big banks, Chase
mentions.falsify_match: Three large US banks, including Chase, take a public position in crypto settlement.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such move by the named banks.

mentions.claim_text: In the same vision Garlinghouse smiles and says all that is needed is clarity and the rest works itself out, standing at the edge of volatile water beside a cable-like rope that takes off.
mentions.quote: All we need is clarity and the rest will work out itself
mentions.falsify_match: Garlinghouse says words to that effect in public after 26 March 2026.

mentions.claim_text: On 18 August a federal judge wrote that XRP in itself is not a security, which Ripple calls clarity for XRP while asking for clarity across the whole industry.
mentions.quote: XRP in and of itself is not a security
mentions.falsify_match: A federal ruling on 18 August 2026 holding XRP itself is not a security.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such ruling on that date.

mentions.claim_text: He treats the 18 August clarity line as matching his March vision word for word, and notes Starlink has partnered with 48 airlines covering over 7,000 aircraft.
mentions.quote: Starlink has now partnered with 48 airlines covering over 7,000 airplanes
mentions.falsify_match: Starlink aviation deals cover 48 airlines and 7,000-plus aircraft by August 2026.

mentions.claim_text: Russia and China pick fights with South Korea in the days ahead, and he plays a report of a convert attempting a terror attack in New York.
mentions.quote: you'll see them picking fights with of South Korea in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Russian or Chinese confrontations with South Korea escalate visibly.
mentions.falsify_miss: Relations with South Korea stay as they are.

mentions.claim_text: Polling shows Rubio outperforming Vance in 2028 matchups against Newsom, Harris and AOC; he says he believes the Lord wants Rubio while Vance takes a running start.
mentions.quote: Rubio outperforms Vance in 2028 matchups
mentions.falsify_match: Rubio becomes the stronger 2028 Republican contender.
mentions.falsify_miss: Vance leads the field or Rubio does not run.

mentions.claim_text: An aside about the new White House helicopter pad and an old Obama umbrella anecdote. No forward-looking claim is made.
mentions.quote: that helicopter pad's neat
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; no prediction present.

mentions.claim_text: In a vision from about a year earlier he saw the autumn bring change, then in January a parchment document resembling the Declaration of Independence.
mentions.quote: I saw a book looked like one of those like the declaration of independence
mentions.falsify_match: A founding-document-style proclamation is signed in January 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such document in that month.

mentions.claim_text: Alongside American digital money platforms he saw oil derricks pumping, heard drill baby drill again, and saw great oil wealth with wells opening everywhere as the document was signed.
mentions.quote: I saw great oil wealth. I'm talking wells opened up everywhere
mentions.falsify_match: A US drilling expansion large enough to be called an oil wealth boom in 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: US production stays flat or falls.

mentions.claim_text: Something is coming with interest rates, and from May through July the economy visibly differs as Senate, House and governor candidates pump it ahead of the 2026 elections.
mentions.quote: May, June, July going into the elections of 2026
mentions.time_phrase: May to July 2026 into the midterms
mentions.falsify_match: Rate cuts and fiscal stimulus visibly lift the economy in the months before the 2026 midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: No rate move or no pre-election lift.

mentions.claim_text: People scoop up gold as fast as they can but it is not a thick enough foundation to build on, while Trump parades a pig wearing makeup that looks pretty but is not.
mentions.quote: Trump was parading a pig, a pig with makeup
mentions.falsify_match: A gold rush accompanies an economy publicly presented as strong but structurally hollow.
mentions.falsify_miss: No gold rush, or the underlying economy proves sound.

mentions.claim_text: He disclaims that any of this is financial advice and says he is only reporting what he saw. No forward-looking claim is made.
mentions.quote: it's not financial advice. This is just a vision
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; a disclaimer.

mentions.claim_text: In a vision dated 3 January, before any US move on Venezuela, he saw battleships all around Venezuela together with Russia.
mentions.quote: I saw battleships all around Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: A naval encirclement or blockade of Venezuela involving US and Russian vessels.

mentions.claim_text: A 6.7 quake plus 7.7s and 7.4s all struck within the past seven days around the ring of fire, which he calls major shakings to awaken the world.
mentions.quote: all kinds of major shakings to awaken all around the world
mentions.severity: multiple M6.7 to M7.7 in seven days
mentions.falsify_match: USGS records several M6.7-plus quakes on the ring of fire in the week to 20 August 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such cluster in that week.

mentions.claim_text: He calls in a caravan of camels loaded with goods and overflow for listeners' households.
mentions.quote: the caravan of camels is coming to my house
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable; a provision declaration over listeners.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that autism will be eradicated and calls for creative miracles over nervous systems and stem cells.
mentions.quote: That autism will be eradicated
mentions.falsify_match: Autism prevalence falls to zero or a cure is established.

mentions.claim_text: He calls a massive turnaround in listeners' children's minds today, and recompense for everything taken from their families.
mentions.quote: today they're going to see a turnaround in Jesus' name
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable; a personal restoration declaration.

mentions.claim_text: He sees companies renting a floor of a building and hunting for space, bringing big staff and many people, tied to May.
mentions.quote: I see space finding space for buildings for these companies
mentions.falsify_match: Large corporate office leasing in the named region around May.

mentions.claim_text: He warns that things which look like they arrive in five or ten years take time to build, and says he hopes but does not assert the rapture happens by 2028.
mentions.quote: what I'm hoping for for the rapture to happen by 2028
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable by ordinary evidence; recorded as a stated hope, not a prediction.

mentions.claim_text: Trump's term ends in 2028 going into 2029; he says the Lord wants to give another round with JD Vance and asks prayer that Vance's heart not turn Judas, with Rubio also named.
mentions.quote: the Lord wants to give another round with JD Vance
mentions.falsify_match: Vance takes the presidency or the nomination in 2028.

mentions.claim_text: He prays against Newsom and Harris and against a socialist agenda causing confusion in the camp, saying it grows strong in the south and the west before people reject it.
mentions.quote: confusion in the camp with the socialist agenda
mentions.condition_text: spoken as a prayer against the outcome
mentions.falsify_match: A socialist-branded movement gains ground in the US south and west and is then publicly rejected.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement or no rejection.

mentions.claim_text: He steers listeners out of poverty for the rest of 2026 into 2027, sees the coin again, and contrasts earthquakes and birth pains with light like Goshen in a dark Egypt.
mentions.quote: We steer this out of poverty for the rest of 2026 into 2027
mentions.falsify_match: A visible transfer of wealth to his audience alongside worsening conditions elsewhere.

mentions.claim_text: God shakes the nation to awaken it, judgment begins with the church, many ministers are exposed and brought into the light, and new Davids are raised up.
mentions.quote: Judgment begins in my house first and he's cleaning up the church
mentions.falsify_match: A run of high-profile ministry scandals through the period he names.

mentions.claim_text: Heaven invades earth beginning in the remainder of 2026 and going full steam ahead in 2027.
mentions.quote: start in 2026 and it's going to go full steam ahead in 2027
mentions.falsify_match: A widely reported revival movement beginning late 2026 and intensifying through 2027.

mentions.claim_text: New York is shaken, Mamdani is shaken, and corruption tied to the five families is exposed, with more of it in 2027.
mentions.quote: Get ready for the shaking on Mandabi and the corruption with the five families
mentions.falsify_match: A corruption scandal touching the New York mayoralty and organised crime families surfaces by end of 2027.
